claim: In Kinesis Data Streams provisioned mode, enhanced fan-out is an optional cost with two cost dimensions, consumer-shard hours and data retrievals. A consumer-shard hour is calculated by multiplying the number of registered stream consumers by the number of shards in the stream.

evidence.quote: Following are two core dimensions and three optional dimensions in Kinesis Data Streams provisioned mode:
A consumer-shard hour is calculated by multiplying the number of registered stream consumers with the number of shards in the stream.

Enhanced fan-out is an optional cost with two cost dimensions: consumer-shard hours and data retrievals. Consumer-shard hours reflect the number of shards in a stream multiplied by the number of consumers using enhanced fan-out.
